sources.title: Retro — A Language for Agents
sources.snippet: Retro is a programming language for AI agents — a retrograde paradigm where you declare guarantees first and refine backwards toward code. A .retro file co-locates intent, architecture, logic, and implementation with a hybrid validator that catches drift between every level.
